On this page

Dropdown ​

Dropdown menu component triggered by an icon avatar with a caret indicator.

Props ​

PropertyTypeRequiredDescription
iconIconType❌Icon displayed as avatar
namestring❌Name displayed in the panel
itemsDropdownItem[]✅Array of dropdown items

DropdownItem:

tsx
type DropdownItem = {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
};

Live Demo ​

Usage Example ​

tsx
import { Dropdown } from "@neus-ui/components";
import { FiUser } from "react-icons/fi";

export function UserDropdown() {
  const items = [
    {
      label: "Profile",
      onClick: () => console.log("Go to profile"),
    },
    {
      label: "Settings",
      onClick: () => console.log("Go to settings"),
    },
    {
      label: "Logout",
      onClick: () => console.log("Logging out..."),
    },
  ];

  return <Dropdown icon={FiUser} name="John Doe" items={items} />;
}
